competitor_signals.signal: Published comprehensive vs. Shiftly comparison page (May 28, 2026) claiming 73+ active dealerships, AI video generation, and 9-platform distribution at $249/month.
competitor_signals.what_it_means: CARVID is actively selling against Shiftly by positioning as the cheaper, multi-platform, video-enabled alternative. This is their core GTM vector right now.
competitor_signals.ventrix_counter_angle: 🔥 Ventrix: Single-tool simplicity. Why toggle between 9 platforms when ONE Chrome extension does Marketplace better? No bloat. No contracts. Just faster posts, more leads. That's it.

competitor_signals.signal: TikTok promotional post (June 22, 2026) advertising waived onboarding fee for new signups. Pricing conflicting reports: Whop lists $129/mo, but CARVID/AutoLister Pro report ~$1,000/mo from dealer surveys.
competitor_signals.what_it_means: Shiftly is running limited-time acquisition promos (fee waiver) to reduce friction. Pricing opacity and aggressive competitor comparisons suggest they're losing share to lower-cost alternatives.
competitor_signals.ventrix_counter_angle: Skip the onboarding theater. Ventrix posts your first car in under 60 seconds—no setup fees, no waiting, no surprises. Straight to results.

competitor_signals.signal: Published detailed comparison vs. Shiftly (July 2026) positioning at $99/mo for individuals, $799/mo for dealerships, with month-to-month contracts and multi-platform posting (Marketplace, Instagram, TikTok).
competitor_signals.what_it_means: AutoLister Pro is directly attacking Shiftly on price (50% lower), contract terms (no upfront commitment), and scope (Instagram + TikTok). Transparent, published pricing is a competitive weapon.
competitor_signals.ventrix_counter_angle: Ventrix transparency: No hidden tiers, no negotiation. See your pricing. See your limits. See your results. Solo reps and teams both fit—one clear path, not a dealer matrix.

competitor_signals.signal: CARVID's compliance guide (May 28, 2026) reports stricter Facebook enforcement as of May 2026: instant 30-day bans (up from 7 days), automatic appeal denial, permanent bans for second violation within 90 days.
competitor_signals.what_it_means: Facebook's band-and-appeal policy has dramatically tightened this quarter, creating significant risk for tools that don't automate compliance (posting intervals, daily limits, unique descriptions, sold-car removal).
competitor_signals.ventrix_counter_angle: Ventrix compliance shields you: Smart spacing, daily caps, auto-rotation, sold-car purging—all baked in. Post fast, post safe. Never wonder if you're one post away from a 30-day ban.

competitor_signals.signal: Multiple dealer forums (Feb-June 2026) cite response speed as top differentiator: leads that wait 14+ hours for human reply often convert to competitors. Consistent posting outperforms sporadic posting 5:1.
competitor_signals.what_it_means: The industry consensus is that speed (posting consistency AND lead response) is the bottleneck. Tools that reduce friction on both fronts will win dealership wallet share.
competitor_signals.ventrix_counter_angle: Ventrix = friction-free volume. Set it once, Marketplace stays filled. Every car gets fresh visibility without manual babysitting. While competitors tinker, your reps close deals.

competitor_signals.signal: New entrant announced AI-powered Facebook Marketplace tool (Feb 3, 2026) supporting AutoTrader, Cars.com, CarGurus, Gumtree imports. Targeting mid-market dealers globally, positioning as paid-ad alternative.
competitor_signals.what_it_means: International expansion signal: Facebook Marketplace automation is moving beyond US. New players entering with inventory scraping + AI description generation. Global competitive pressure rising.
competitor_signals.ventrix_counter_angle: Ventrix ships where dealers are. Built for the American dealer. Built for the American Marketplace. Local > global when it comes to compliance and conversion.

competitor_signals.competitor: ZenLitePro, Glo3D, Drift, LocalShift, AutoBeacon AI (mentioned collectively)
competitor_signals.signal: CARVID's June 2026 comparison guide lists 8+ competitors (ZenLitePro, Glo3D, Drift, LocalShift, Lazy Poster, etc.). All cited as either manual workflows, photo-only, single-platform, or lacking AI video/CRM integration.

competitor_signals.ventrix_counter_angle: Ventrix focuses on one job done right: Get your car listed faster than the other guy. No video bloat, no DMS delays, no learning curve. Chrome extension. One click. Done.
